envelope.description: The chat host posts the outbox and handles its actions

body.title: The chat host posts the outbox and handles its actions
body.summary: In chat-panel.ts createChatPanelHost: subscribe to worker.onChange and keep the last rows; post the projected view for the shown chat after every change, in showSession, on 'ready' and after an action. Route outbox-cancel / -dismiss / -resend to worker.act (ignoring a seq that is not the shown chat's; outbox-retry-now ignored until s4) and re-post with the note on refusal.
acceptanceChecks: Messages sent while a turn runs appear in the posted outbox with their places, and leave it when they are taken
Cancel, dismiss and resend from the webview change the queue; a refused action is re-posted with its note; a seq of another chat is ignored
After the host is rebuilt over the same file and its webview is ready, the same outbox is posted
Without the queue no 'outbox' message is posted

tests.name: chat host outbox: two messages sent while a turn runs are posted in the outbox with their places, and another chat's earlier message is counted ahead
chat host outbox: cancelling a waiting message removes it from the queue and the outbox, and it never runs
chat host outbox: resending a failed message queues the same text and attachments at the back under this window's key, and it runs
chat host outbox: a refused action is re-posted with its note, a seq of another chat is ignored, and a taken message leaves the outbox
chat host outbox: after the host is rebuilt over the same queue file and its webview is ready, the outbox shows the same messages in the same places
